name: Terror Glyphs
disable: DC 38 Acrobatics check or DC 38 Athletics check (expert) to move through the area before the glyph activates, DC 40 Arcana check (expert) to unweave the glyph's animating magic, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 36)

items.name: Terrifying Message
items.text:
Trigger A living creature moves into the trapped area

---
Effect The glyph scuttles in front of the triggering creature and rearranges itself to spell out a terrifying threat, such as "You are about to die." The creature attempts a DC 40 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round. A fleeing creature moves toward the nearest trapped area, or in a random direction if no trapped areas remain.

text: Magical glyphs crawl across the floor, ceiling, and walls of the hallway.
